

```{r}
#| include: false
CAP <- "Design Ground Motions in terms of horizontal pseudo-spectral acceleration PSA [%s] for return periods ranging from %s to %s [yr] and structural periods Tn ranging from %g to %g [s]. Spectral ordinates were obtained assuming rock site conditions with Vs30 = %s [m/s]. (p=%s)"
Vs30_TARGET <- 760
TR_TARGET <- TR_gmdp
if (!exists("PSA_Units")) PSA_Units <- "cm/s2"
if (!exists("ID_TARGET")) ID_TARGET <- ID_max
Tn_TARGET <- c(0.05,0.1,0.2,0.5,1.0,2.0,5.0)
root <- here::here()          
if (!exists("p_TARGET")) p_TARGET <- "mean"
```

```{r}
#| include: true

source(file.path(root,"scripts","tbl/PSA.R"))
TBL
```
